summary: Build the middleware/hooks pipeline at packages/python/src/sox_protocol/core/middleware/ per ADR 0003. Deliver: (1) a normative MiddlewareContext dataclass and Middleware Protocol matching spec/ports/middleware.md §3; (2) a Pipeline runner that composes an ordered list of middlewares around a terminal store_dispatch handler with strict short-circuit and reentrancy semantics; (3) a registry that loads middlewares declaratively (importable factory paths or in-process registration), validates must_run_before/must_run_after constraints, and assembles the default chain (namespace_resolver → auth → rate_limit → schema_validator → idempotency → store_dispatch → audit_log); (4) a hook_dispatcher middleware that fans out registered pre_<verb>/post_<verb> observation-only hooks; (5) the auth plugin which is a thin shim over the IdentityVerifier public API delivered by the identity-primitive engagement — NO duplication of identity logic; (6) one sample logging plugin that writes one JSON line per call to ~/.sox/logs/middleware.jsonl (path injectable). Tests live under packages/python/tests/middleware/ and one regression run under tests/identity/ proves the migration kept identity behaviour intact. Build order: protocol/context → errors → pipeline → registry → hooks → plugins/audit_log → plugins/auth → default chain → tests → identity migration shim.

files.purpose: Public re-exports forming the stable middleware API.

MiddlewareContext dataclass scoped to a single tool call; mutability rules from §6 enforced via property setters that raise on illegal writes (e.g. correlation_id, connection_id are read-only after construction).
public_api: @dataclass class MiddlewareContext(operation: Literal['send','recv','subscribe','list_channels','channels_ack','channels_heartbeat','channels_collect','replay'], input: dict[str,object], connection_id: str, agent_id: str | None = None, metadata: dict[str,object] = field(default_factory=dict))
def freeze_correlation_id(self) -> None  # called by Pipeline after construction

files.purpose: Middleware Protocol type — the host-language binding of the normative async fn handle(request, next) -> response signature.
public_api: class Middleware(Protocol): name: str; must_run_before: tuple[str, ...]; must_run_after: tuple[str, ...]; async def __call__(self, ctx: MiddlewareContext, call_next: Callable[[MiddlewareContext], Awaitable[dict[str,object]]]) -> dict[str,object]

files.purpose: Typed exception/response classes used to short-circuit. ShortCircuitResponse wraps a sox-error-shaped dict; MiddlewareError converts uncaught exceptions to internal_error envelopes per §7.
Pipeline composes middlewares around a terminal handler. Each call is reentrant: a fresh MiddlewareContext per dispatch. Catches middleware exceptions, converts to internal_error per §7.
public_api: class Pipeline(middlewares: list[Middleware], terminal: Callable[[MiddlewareContext], Awaitable[dict[str,object]]])
async def dispatch(self, operation: str, input: dict[str,object], *, connection_id: str) -> dict[str,object]
class PipelineBuilder: def add(mw: Middleware) -> Self; def build(terminal) -> Pipeline

files.purpose: MiddlewareRegistry collects middleware factories by name and assembles ordered chains, validating must_run_before/must_run_after constraints. Supports in-process register_middleware() (used by tests outside core) and entry-point loading at server startup.
public_api: def register(self, name: str, factory: Callable[[], Middleware]) -> None
def get(self, name: str) -> Callable[[], Middleware]
def assemble(self, order: list[str]) -> list[Middleware]  # raises ChainConfigurationError on conflict

files.purpose: HookDispatcher middleware reads registered pre_<verb>/post_<verb> hooks and fans them out around the rest of the chain. A hook may return HookDecision(action='allow'|'deny', error: dict | None) but cannot mutate ctx — we pass an immutable view.
public_api: class Hook(Protocol): async def __call__(self, ctx_view: Mapping[str,object]) -> HookDecision | None
@dataclass class HookDecision(action: Literal['allow','deny'], error: dict[str,object] | None = None)
class HookDispatcher(pre: dict[str, list[Hook]], post: dict[str, list[Hook]]): name='hook_dispatcher'

files.purpose: Plugin namespace marker.

Auth middleware plugin wrapping the identity-primitive IdentityVerifier. Calls verifier.verify() to populate ctx.agent_id; calls verifier.bind_for_send() on send to overwrite input.sender. Short-circuits with sox-error error_code='identity_failure' on any IdentityFailure subclass. This is the migration target from core/identity/middleware.py.
public_api: def build_auth_middleware(verifier: IdentityVerifier) -> AuthMiddleware  # entry-point factory shape

files.purpose: Sample observation-only plugin: writes one JSONL line per call to a configurable path (default ~/.sox/logs/middleware.jsonl, created on first write). Demonstrates a plugin that lives at the bottom of the chain post-store_dispatch.
public_api: class LoggingMiddleware(path: pathlib.Path | None = None, *, clock: Callable[[], float] = time.time): name='middleware_log'; must_run_after=('store_dispatch',)

files.purpose: Terminal middleware: invokes the configured BackingStore method matching ctx.operation. The only chain link allowed to perform persistence.

Defines the normative default order and a build_default_pipeline() helper that composes Pipeline from the supplied verifier + store. Other links (namespace_resolver, rate_limit, schema_validator, idempotency, audit_log) are referenced by name and resolved from the registry; if not registered, they are skipped with a startup warning so the v1 chain remains usable while sibling engagements catch up.
public_api: def build_default_pipeline(*, verifier: IdentityVerifier, store: BackingStore, registry: MiddlewareRegistry | None = None) -> Pipeline

files.purpose: MIGRATION SHIM. After this engagement, this module re-exports AuthMiddleware from middleware.plugins.auth so any existing imports keep working. New code MUST import from sox_protocol.core.middleware.plugins.auth.
Package marker.
Fixtures: stub BackingStore, stub IdentityVerifier, tmp middleware-log path, helper to construct MiddlewareContext.
Order, short-circuit, response propagation, exception-to-internal_error conversion.
Mutability rules: correlation_id immutable, agent_id only settable once, connection_id read-only, metadata mutable.

Constraint validation, missing-link error, entry-point loading via stub, OUT-OF-CORE registration smoke (test imports register_middleware from middleware package and registers a custom plugin defined in the test module).
pre/post fan-out, deny-decision short-circuit, immutability of ctx_view passed to hooks.
Conformance: default chain refuses an unauthenticated send (the canonical footgun test); namespace_resolver runs before auth when both registered; chain still builds when optional links absent.
Auth plugin populates ctx.agent_id from verifier; bind_for_send overwrites sender; IdentityFailure converts to identity_failure sox-error short-circuit.
Logging plugin appends one JSONL line per dispatched call, redacts no caller fields, creates parent dir on first write.

A custom Middleware class defined inside the test module is registered via register_middleware (i.e., from outside core/) and exercised end-to-end through Pipeline.dispatch — proves no core code change is needed to add a plugin.

Re-runs the identity rejection scenarios using the new AuthMiddleware via Pipeline.dispatch (rather than the standalone IdentityMiddleware) and asserts identical outcomes — the migration regression check.

risks.risk: Plugins like namespace_resolver, rate_limit, schema_validator, idempotency, audit_log are owned by other engagements and may not exist when this lands.
risks.mitigation: build_default_pipeline tolerates missing optional links with a startup warning; the conformance test only requires auth + store_dispatch present. As sibling engagements ship, they register into the same MiddlewareRegistry.

risks.risk: MiddlewareContext exposing the full operation enum may drift from spec as new operations are added.
risks.mitigation: The Literal enum mirrors the 8 ops listed in spec/operations/; a test asserts every spec/operations/*.input.schema.json filename has a matching enum member, failing CI if drift occurs.

risks.risk: Identity migration could break existing imports of sox_protocol.core.identity.middleware.IdentityMiddleware.
risks.mitigation: Keep core/identity/middleware.py as a re-export shim aliasing AuthMiddleware; the existing identity tests run unchanged. Marked deprecated in module docstring.

risks.risk: Out-of-core plugin registration may inadvertently allow a plugin to bypass auth by inserting before it.
risks.mitigation: MiddlewareRegistry.assemble enforces must_run_before/must_run_after; AuthMiddleware declares must_run_after=('namespace_resolver',) and must_run_before=('rate_limit','schema_validator','idempotency','store_dispatch'). A negative test attempts to insert a plugin before auth and asserts ChainConfigurationError.

risks.risk: Hook short-circuit response shape could diverge from sox-error envelope.
risks.mitigation: HookDecision(action='deny') is converted by HookDispatcher into a sox-error via errors.make_internal_error / a dedicated factory; jsonschema-validated in test_hooks.py.

risks.risk: channels_ack is a tool, not a message — a plugin could try to write ACK envelopes into ctx.input.body.
risks.mitigation: default_chain documents the 8 operations; schema_validator (when present) blocks body.type='sox-ack' on send. The pipeline itself does not police body shapes; this risk is filed for the schema_validator engagement.

Out-of-core plugin registration exercised by tests/middleware/test_external_plugin.py (no core file modified by the test)
lint-imports clean (core/middleware/plugins/auth.py imports from core/identity, NOT from adapters)
Conformance footgun test passes: default chain refuses an unauthenticated send
migration_notes: The identity-primitive engagement ships these stable public symbols which this engagement consumes WITHOUT duplication: IdentityVerifier (core surface), SignedRequest, VerifiedIdentity, IdentityFailure (and subclasses UnknownAgentError, RevokedCredentialError, SignatureMismatchError, ReplayDetectedError), AuditLogWriter, CredentialRegistry. The identity-primitive's IdentityVerifier.verify(request, *, operation, connection_id) becomes the single call site inside AuthMiddleware.__call__; IdentityVerifier.bind_for_send(request, send_input) becomes the call AuthMiddleware uses on operation=='send' to overwrite ctx.input['sender']. The identity-primitive's standalone IdentityMiddleware (core/identity/middleware.py) is REPLACED by a re-export shim aliasing AuthMiddleware so existing imports keep working; the shim is marked deprecated in its docstring. AuditLogWriter is constructed by the auth plugin and passed to the verifier; logging behaviour is unchanged so the identity engagement's test_audit_log.py keeps passing without modification. No identity logic is reimplemented inside core/middleware/.
